regression_results.query: Can a delayed physical equipment request or receipt fire a replaced, dropped or cancelled tool, and how is the worker queue bounded?
regression_results.bounded_answer_from_saved_context: An old request cannot legitimately fire a replaced or cancelled tool: physical actions are bound to issued observation/lease and usable_index, instance_id and equipment_epoch, with owner-built body/frame identity. Admission is atomic and bounded to8global,1unconsumed per actor including extracted work. Cancellation shares the mutex with finite consumption; after it returns old pending work cannot commit a later cell edit, and duplicate receipts cannot repeat recoil. Already committed projectiles/devices retain their own lifetime.
